author: F2F official
description: A 1950s English housing estate with three lanes north to south: the West Lane, Ashby Avenue in the middle and Fen Walk. A: the Green, by the West Gate off the avenue or the Fen Gap off Fen Walk. B: the Lock-ups garage court, by the Ginnel Mouth off the avenue, Chapel Path or Church Walk from the West Lane.
name: Barnwell
